verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a per-PR Merge Readiness score and a codebase reliability/security analysis panel. Both are adjacent features: neither is a report that evaluates how ready the repository is for autonomous agents. The onboarding agent sets up the environment but is not documented as producing any readiness assessment.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents
